# Version 4.155.3 (Unreleased)
> **Uno WebAssembly linking fix**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.3 fixes Uno 6.x WebAssembly linking with the Skia renderer on .NET 9 and later.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Avoid conflicting WebGPU linker options** — Uno WebAssembly apps on .NET 9 and later no longer receive -sUSE_WEBGPU, which conflicts with Dawn's emdawnwebgpu port. The flag remains enabled for net8.0, which still uses Emscripten's built-in WebGPU port. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5835](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5835))
